full_coupled_F_term_audit.why_this_is_a_coupled_audit: The cubic scan has no potentially PS-invariant source--host term after its necessary PS-singlet filter, so at renormalizable order the displayed source F equations and the arbitrary F-flat host equations are simultaneously valid.

conditional_FI_escape.assumption: A positive constant xi_S is inserted into D_S/gS = |STheta|^2-|ThetaMinus|^2-|Omega|^2+xi_S.
conditional_FI_escape.equation_on_F_branch: alpha x^2+x-xi_S=0, with x=|ThetaPlus|^2=|ThetaMinus|^2 and alpha=|kappa/M_Omega|^2.
conditional_FI_escape.positive_solution: x=(-1+sqrt(1+4 alpha xi_S))/(2 alpha) for xi_S>0.
conditional_FI_escape.why_not_a_completion: A constant FI datum and the anomaly/UV completion of U(1)_S are additional physics. They are not supplied by this minimal spurion Lagrangian.

zero_FI_D_terms.proof: The two nonzero U(1)_S-negative F-branch VEV contributions cannot be balanced in the minimal field set, independent of couplings or of the individual Theta phases.

neutral_compensator_recurrence.attempt: Add a U(1)_F-neutral, U(1)_S=+1, Z4R-neutral field OmegaBar whose VEV would cancel the minimal D_S contribution without an FI term.
neutral_compensator_recurrence.minimal_compensator_class_no_go: If the positive compensator is neutral under U(1)_F and the old selectors and preserves Z4R, then its product with Omega is neutral under every declared factor. The generic X/Zp portal is therefore unavoidable. A differently charged or non-minimal compensator is a new model requiring a fresh F/D, residual-group, anomaly, mass, and operator audit.

new_U1S_anomaly_audit.conclusion: The U(1)_S label cannot yet be promoted to a completed gauge symmetry. Any spectator or Green--Schwarz repair must be added explicitly, massed, and re-audited for source-host portals.
new_U1S_anomaly_audit.convention: PS rows use the V40 doubled-Dynkin coefficients; abelian gravity/cubic rows use physical Weyl-component multiplicities.

unchanged_U1F_only_check.scope_limit: This closes local anomalies of PS times U(1)_F.  The unspecified continuous parent, if any, of Z5610 is not included, so product cross anomalies remain open.

renormalizable_source_host_portal_audit.important_limit: This is a complete renormalizable abelian scan plus a necessary PS-singlet filter. It is not a classification of arbitrary higher-dimensional operators involving charged V40 host fields.
renormalizable_source_host_portal_audit.method: All monomials of degree one through three are first filtered only by the declared abelian factors. A gauge invariant mixed portal would have to survive this superset.

restricted_all_order_driver_source_ring.conclusion: No polynomial X/Zp portal made only from source-branch VEV fields survives on the STheta=0 branch. Any allowed nontrivial restricted-ring portal contains STheta.
derivation: Z4R requires 2+2 n(STheta) = 2 mod 4, so n(STheta) is even.

restricted_all_order_driver_source_ring.scope_limit: The theorem deliberately excludes arbitrary additional V40 host fields; those require a separate higher-dimensional PS/operator-ring audit before any proton or full-vacuum claim.
